data_quality_assurance: In the SHAREWIND project, we have established comprehensive procedures for quality assurance to ensure the integrity and reliability of our research data. These documented procedures encompass a range of practices aimed at validating the cleanliness, consistency, and overall quality of the data. To achieve this, we employ tools and scripts tailored to the specific characteristics of our dataset, enabling automated checks for duplicates, inconsistencies, and proper data structuring. Our quality assurance framework is designed to address potential errors at various stages of the data lifecycle, from collection to analysis. These procedures are documented in detail, outlining the specific checks performed, the tools utilized, and the criteria for data validation. Regular audits and reviews will be conducted to maintain the effectiveness of our quality assurance measures, providing confidence in the accuracy and reliability of the research data throughout the project's duration. Any updates or modifications to these procedures will be duly documented and communicated, ensuring transparency and adherence to best practices in research data management.
dataset.description:
The SHAREWIND project aims to generate comprehensive datasets through a combination of experiments and numerical simulations. The dataset will encompass various formats to capture the diverse nature of the research:

CSV (.csv) files: These files will contain measured data from sensors utilized in centrifuge experiments and data points derived from processed numerical models.

MP4 files: Video recordings of the experiments will be stored in this format, providing visual documentation of the research processes.

JPEG files: Images and photographs relevant to the experiments and simulations will be represented in JPEG format.

Text files (.txt): Metadata associated with the dataset will be stored in plain text files, providing essential information about the experimental setup and numerical models.

DXF files: Computer-assisted drawings of schemas will be documented in DXF format, facilitating a visual representation of experimental and numerical configurations.

PDF and .tex files: Text documents, including research reports and technical documentation, will be stored in both PDF and LaTeX (.tex) formats.
dataset.preservation_statement: As previously mentioned, Zenodo guarantees storage for at least 20 years, ensuring a long-term preservation commitment. In addition to Zenodo, local copies of all datasets will be preserved on the Université Gustave Eiffel servers, providing an additional layer of security and redundancy. Furthermore, external hard drives will be kept in the laboratory facilities, serving as another measure to safeguard the datasets. These multi-tiered preservation policies and practices ensure the resilience and longevity of the described dataset/output, mitigating the risk of data loss and supporting sustained access for future research and use

dmp.description: This document describes the lifecycle of the data to be collected, processed, and generated by the SHAREWIND project. It provides a summary of anticipated data types, formats, and structures, detailing the considerations and strategies to implement FAIR data principles. The current Data Management Plan includes a data summary, considerations for making data FAIR, details on other research outputs, allocation of resources, data security, ethics, and other relevant issues. The Data Management Plan for the SHAREWIND project is a dynamic document that will be updated throughout the development of the project. This version of the document represents the first submission of the Data Management Plan in December 2023.
